description: Use this when you need to know WHAT MATERIAL changed between two versions of a model, not just how much. The deeper sibling of diff_scripts: a volume delta alone is ambiguous (a boss that grew and a pocket that deepened report the same magnitude, and a part that only moved reports zero), so this tool answers it with geometry instead of pixels. Baseline is { baseFile } or { baseCode }; the revised side is either another script ({ file } or { code }) or the SAME script re-lowered with { params } overrides — a bag of declared param() name -> new value, which is the one-script form a parameter sweep actually asks for. Bodies pair by name and fall back to declaration-order positional pairing; anything left over is listed in `unmatched` and raises diff.body.unmatched. Per matched body it returns addedMm3 = volume(revised - base), removedMm3 = volume(base - revised), commonMm3 = volume(base ∩ revised) from OCCT booleans, exact bbox with min/max/extent deltas, face / edge / hole count deltas (hole counts reuse the cylindrical-hole detector), maxDeviationMm (two-sided discrete Hausdorff distance between the two surfaces), and a `verdict` — identical | moved | resized | topology-changed, precedence topology-changed > resized > moved > identical. Branch on the verdict; cite the numbers. Optional { render: true } also writes an overlay PNG (added green, removed red, unchanged material as a translucent ghost; the scene is a re-runnable .kcad.ts over lossless BREP sidecars) through the render_preview pipeline and fails open (the numeric diff is still returned) when that pipeline is unavailable. Read-only — never touches the active session.

baseFile.description: Baseline script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

code.description: Revised script — inline source. Mutually exclusive with params.

file.description: Revised script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Mutually exclusive with params. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

out_dir.description: Directory for the overlay PNG, its STL inputs, and the generated overlay script. Default: a temp dir.

params.description: Param-override mode: re-lower the BASELINE with these declared param() values changed (e.g. { plateThickness: 8 }). Mutually exclusive with file/code. A name the baseline does not declare fails with the declared-param list in the message.

render.description: Also render an overlay PNG — added material green, removed material red — via the render_preview pipeline. Off by default; the numeric table is the agent-facing evidence.

name: diff_geometry

bodies.description: Per matched body, the material-level delta (success).

bbox.description: Exact bbox both sides plus min/max/extent deltas (mm).

commonMm3.description: volume(base ∩ revised) — material that stayed put.

edgeCount.description: { base, revised, delta } BREP edge count.

faceCount.description: { base, revised, delta } BREP face count.

maxDeviationMm.description: Two-sided discrete Hausdorff distance between the two surfaces.

verdict.description: The field to branch on. Precedence: topology-changed > resized > moved > identical.

render.description: Overlay result when render: true — { ok, images, out_dir, script_path, error? }.

summary.description: Verdict counts plus totalAddedMm3 / totalRemovedMm3 / maxDeviationMm.

unmatched.description: Bodies present on only one side; each also raises diff.body.unmatched.

title: Diff Model Geometry
